So the company actually is in an amazing state. In my opinion the One Academy packages are as important as a driver's license. Nobody of you would go and just let its children drive out there without being safe, without having a license license without having some education on the topic and I see the same with cryptocurrency in my opinion nobody should go out there and mine or trade the coin without understanding properly what is cryptocurrency why is it important and how can you change the world so um this is why we have always seen ourselves as an education company and our first physical product the one tablet exactly also reflects on this. The tablet that we have is here to help you learning on the way out because sometimes the phone is too small to watch the videos to to see all the content on the oneAcademy and if you want, it's also a great website to go there and buy any new products there. see all the technical details I think not a lot to say here maybe one of my highlights for this tablet is that you can use a dual SIM card inside and a lot of us travel especially the top leaders so you guys know how difficult it is to travel from another country to another country and how often we change SIM cards so this is something that I actually like a lot, about the tablet. It is quite light, you can expand the storage memory and whoever hold it in the hand knows that it is actually also a very very user friendly and useable. But now, what I want to talk to you, is about the details . So the one tablet is priced, as a standard Trader package, so we have priced it at 550 Euro. You can order through your cash account or you can send the wire to the company. Now, very, very important, when you wire money for the tablet please send us your username but also indicate us that this money is going for your tablet package. Because the NiceLadiesInIaccounting will activate you on a normal trader package. It is very, very important, If you want to have a tablet package and wire money to the company, please state in the wire instructions that this was a tablet. As always with OneCoin 550 euro generates 550 BV. You also get a promotion from us 500 tokens which we'll split like a trader package and of course, you course a two years warranty. After this our company will ship the product you will receive a shipment confirmation by email and a tracking ID to track the package. Thank you. And goodbye.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the presenter promotes OneCoin's OneTablet as a way to earn additional income, including up to €3,500 in extra max-out, and urges viewers to buy it through the company or back office. The solicitation directs viewers to pay €550 plus shipping, with wire transfers or account funds, and ties further bonuses to downline tablet sales. The webinar presents this as a product and income opportunity, not as reporting or criticism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The offered additional income depends on holding a tablet package and on downline tablet sales, with network and matching bonuses described. The speaker also says non-distributors can buy the physical tablet; the downline mechanism is the basis for this subtype, not the product purchase alone.
